summary: Ollama integrations are the tools and libraries that connect to a local or cloud Ollama server. The ollama launch command sets up and runs coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex with local or cloud models; the Go api package, ollama-python and ollama-js read OLLAMA_HOST; langchain-ollama provides ChatOllama; editors (Cline, Roo Code, Zed, JetBrains, VS Code), MCP bridges (ollmcp, MCPHost), agent harnesses (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Pi) and n8n nodes connect through the native or OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Sources: docs.ollama.com plus vendor docs, READMEs and community posts.

Toggling the `num_ctx` control on **pre-fills it with `2048`**, which is very small, so it is easy to cap a model at 2048 tokens without realizing it, even after raising `OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH` on the Ollama side.
